resumeText:
Priya Raghavan | Bengaluru | priya.raghavan@example.com

EXPERIENCE
CRM Executive, Thali Box Foods (food delivery app), Bengaluru (2022 - present)
- Run push notification campaigns and in-app messaging campaigns in CleverTap for 3 million monthly users.
- Built onboarding journeys and win-back campaigns triggered by order behaviour.
- Created RFM segmentation and behavioural segmentation for city and cuisine offers.
- Ran A/B tests on send time and creatives, lifting repeat orders by 6 percent.
- Wrote SQL queries in Redshift to report campaign conversions every week.
- Plan monthly campaign calendars with the product and growth teams.

Email Marketing Associate, Kaveri Retail, Bengaluru (2020 - 2022)
- Sent weekly email campaigns to loyalty members using a drag-and-drop editor.

EDUCATION
MBA Marketing, Christ University, Bengaluru, 2020

SKILLS
CleverTap, MoEngage, SQL, Excel, email deliverability
